svg.title: Liner system schematic, v1.9
svg.desc: Liner's system: a phone or laptop dashboard, Volumio 4's REST API, the wsrv.nl proxy and Tidal CDN connect over Wi-Fi to the ESP32-S3 (flash with OTA slots, PSRAM with a four-cover cache, NVS settings, network stack, M5GFX). GPIO buttons send next, previous and setup. The Spectra 6 e-paper panel shows the art. The main loop reads buttons, serves the web, polls Volumio every 2 seconds, uses cached covers, draws, and pre-fetches the next two covers.
svg.text: also: setup QR ×2 · Volumio-down QR · idle
refresh 14.8 s (measured) · redraw only on track change
panel refreshes on its own; Liner keeps serving
mpd → local /albumart direct · tidal & other URLs → wsrv.nl · cache 4 covers (LRU) · pre-fetch from getQueue, skipped on shuffle
idle 5 min → generative Spectra 6 screensaver · Volumio down ~15 s → QR screen · Wi-Fi lost → setup AP, retry every 2 min
